> **Lens**: A quality bar stated over every permutation of the data is only checkable if every state is addressable by URL.
> Something must also sweep them all.

## Relates to

- Extends [ADR-0020](0020-captured-report-is-a-static-microsite.md) (the record's status line says "refines")
- Extends [ADR-0024](0024-context-window-metrics-injected-messages-and-design-tokens.md) (the record's status line says "refines")
- Supersedes [ADR-0024](0024-context-window-metrics-injected-messages-and-design-tokens.md) (supersedes the fold-onto-the-last-colour series rule only)
- Extends [ADR-0025](0025-results-name-their-case-and-charts-have-a-log-line-axis.md) (the record's status line says "refines")
- Extends [ADR-0028](0028-report-is-built-from-a-component-workspace.md) (the record's status line says "refines")
- Supersedes [ADR-0028](0028-report-is-built-from-a-component-workspace.md) (supersedes the shadcn/recharts component stack only)

## Problem

### Symptom

0028 built the report page from a Vite workspace on shadcn/ui (radix) with recharts, smoke-tested by rendering the bundle in jsdom.
Three pressures outgrew that stack:

- The charts are the product.
  recharts composes primitives well, but tops out early.
  Its legends overflowed the card on sweeps with many sessions, and unified hover, SI ticks and step-stacked areas each needed hand-rolling.
- The page's quality bar is "AAA for every permutation of the results data".
  That is only checkable if every state is addressable by URL and something sweeps them all.
- Two component systems (radix primitives styled by Tailwind classes) meant every interactive state was styled twice and animated nowhere.

### Pain point

jsdom cannot render the real page (no layout, no canvas), so the smoke proved boot, not behaviour.

## Decision

### The lens

- **Given**: The one static file must route with zero server rewrites and over `file://`.
- **We prefer**: Plotly on a Tamagui base with History-API query-string routes and a tiered Playwright sweep, over recharts on shadcn/radix smoke-tested in jsdom.
- **Because**: A quality bar stated over every permutation is only checkable if every state is addressable by URL.
  Something must also sweep them all in a real browser.
- **Unless**: never

### In practice

- Three moves, one per pressure.
- **Plotly.js draws every chart.** `plotly.js-basic-dist-min` (scatter and bar, all the page needs) goes through one mount point, `components/charts/Plot.tsx`.
  Layouts are built from `useChartTheme()`, which resolves the `--xh-*` custom properties to concrete values and re-resolves when the theme flips.
  0024's design tokens therefore still own every colour.
  Legends are DOM (`ChartLegend`): flexbox chips that wrap instead of overflowing and toggle a trace by re-rendering it as `legendonly`.
  Series past the eight-colour token palette cycle through it, with a different line dash per lap.
  That supersedes 0024's rule that a ninth session folds onto the last colour, which made nine of sixteen lines identical.
- **Tamagui is the base UI and animation framework.** `components/ui/*` are hand-written Tamagui components now, not shadcn output; radix and Tailwind are both gone.
  Layout, chrome and interactivity are Tamagui components with props.
  The Tamagui themes hold `var(--xh-*)` references, both light and dark on purpose.
  0024's `.dark` class flip on the root already swaps the underlying values.
  Document content is semantic HTML, styled by one hand-written stylesheet (`index.css`) and token-driven like everything else.
  That content is tables, record cards, code blocks and key/value grids.
  One trap is load-bearing.
  Tamagui injects its atomic classes at runtime, after the stylesheet.
  Chrome that must overrule it, such as the segmented control, is therefore pinned with `!important`.
  Positioning on Tamagui components is set through props, never classes.
- **Every state deeplinks, and one Playwright test sweeps the matrix.** The URL is the single source of truth.
  The routes are real History-API routes as query strings, not a fragment router.
  Query rather than path segments, because the one static file must route with zero server rewrites and over `file://`.
  `session`, `turn` and `view` keep their 0020 meanings.
  They are joined by `axis` (0025's log-line axis) and `rec` (raw/nice records).
  `line` is a record-level permalink that opens its owning turn and flashes the card.
  `sort` and `dir` (overview table) and `theme` join them too.
  A param absent from the URL means its default.
  State never sticks across navigations, navigations push history entries, and legacy `#…` links upgrade to their query form on load.
  `lib/permutations.ts` enumerates the covering matrix from the captured data itself.
  That is every turn of every session in both views, plus one permutation per remaining param per view type.
  Each state gets a deterministic filesystem-safe slug.
  The matrix is tiered.
  `small` constrains every dimension to one representative value: one session per harness, one mid turn, detailed view only.
  `medium` constrains each to a few: one session per harness×model, first/middle/last turns, every variant.
  `large` uses all of them.
  The inner loop therefore stays seconds long, and the full-cost sweep is absorbed less frequently.
  Tiers nest by slug, so a faster run refreshes a subset of the same artifact tree.
  The singular `e2e/matrix.spec.ts` full-loads each permutation in a real browser, and asserts zero console errors.
  It saves the screenshot, console transcript and network timings under `tmp/e2e/matrix/<slug>/`.
  That slug is the shared, precise language for "this exact state is broken".
  The jsdom smoke is replaced by `e2e/inline.spec.ts`, which opens the inline-populated build over `file://` and checks the glossary-id parity list in a real browser.

## Consequences

### Pros

- `make ui-e2e CAPTURED=<dir> TIER=small|medium|large` sweeps the matrix (`SAMPLE=<n>` for an evenly spaced sample, `E2E_TARGET=dev` against the dev server); `make ui-smoke` needs a browser, not jsdom.
- `window.__XH_PENDING__` (in-flight loads) and `[data-xh-loading]` markers are the page's settledness contract with the e2e suite.

### Cons

- Playwright's chromium must be installed once (`bunx playwright install chromium`).
- The bundle grows to ~1.7 MB (Plotly basic inlined); still one file, still offline.
- A new route param must be added to `lib/permutations.ts` in the same change, or the matrix silently stops covering it.
